entries.title: Ezekiel 25:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:2
segments: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:3
segments: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:4
segments: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk. {men: Heb. children}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:5
segments: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:6
segments: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped [thine] hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel; {hands: Heb. hand} {feet: Heb. foot} {heart: Heb. soul}

words.text: ; {hands: Heb. hand} {feet: Heb. foot} {heart: Heb. soul}

segments: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD. {a spoil: or, meat}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:8
segments: ¶Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah [is] like unto all the heathen;

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:9
segments: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities [which are] on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim, {side...: Heb. shoulder of Moab}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:10
segments: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations. {with...: or, against the children of Ammon}

words.text: . {with...: or, against the children of Ammon}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:11
segments: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:12
segments: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them; {by...: Heb. by revenging revengement}

words.text: himself upon them; {by...: Heb. by revenging revengement}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:13
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword. {they...: or, they shall fall by the sword unto Dedan}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:14
segments: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:15
segments: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy [it] for the old hatred; {for the...: or, with perpetual hatred}

entries.title: Ezekiel 25:16
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast. {sea coast: or, haven of the sea}
